behaviours.title: An account never opened reads as balance 0 and empty history
behaviours.given: a new Ledger with no accounts
behaviours.when: balance and entries are read for account 'ghost'
behaviours.then: balance is 0 and entries is an empty list
behaviours.contrary_then: reading an unknown account fails or returns no balance (undefined)

behaviours.title: Opening an existing account again does not reset it
behaviours.given: account 'a' has received a deposit of 100 (txn 't1')
behaviours.then: the balance stays 100 and the history still holds the one deposit
behaviours.contrary_then: the account is reset to balance 0 with an empty history

behaviours.title: A deposit to a new account opens it and records the deposit
behaviours.then: the result is ok, balance of 'a' is 100 and history has one deposit entry of 100 with txnId 't1'
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is rejected because account 'a' was never opened

behaviours.title: A deposit of 0 is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } and balance of 'a' stays 0 with no history
behaviours.contrary_then: a zero deposit is accepted as a no-op and recorded in history

behaviours.title: A negative deposit is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } and the balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the negative deposit is accepted and the balance becomes 95

behaviours.title: A deposit of NaN is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.when: NaN is deposited into 'a' with txn 't1'
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' }
behaviours.contrary_then: the NaN deposit is accepted

behaviours.title: A rejected (invalid-amount) deposit does not use up its txnId
behaviours.given: a deposit of 0 into 'a' with txn 't1' was rejected
behaviours.when: 100 is deposited into 'a' with the same txn 't1'
behaviours.then: the deposit is applied: balance of 'a' is 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the second deposit is treated as a retry of 't1' and ignored, balance stays 0

behaviours.title: The amount check runs before the retry check
behaviours.given: a deposit of 100 into 'a' with txn 't1' has been accepted
behaviours.when: a deposit of 0 is made with the same txn 't1'
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } rather than the retry's ok
behaviours.contrary_then: the call is recognised as a retry of 't1' and returns { ok: true }

behaviours.title: Retrying a deposit with the same txnId is a no-op that reports success
behaviours.when: the deposit of 100 with txn 't1' is sent again
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true }, balance stays 100 and history still has one entry
behaviours.contrary_then: the retry is applied again and the balance becomes 200

behaviours.title: A reused txnId with a different amount is silently ignored
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true } and the balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the call is rejected as a conflicting reuse of 't1' (ok false)

behaviours.title: txnIds are shared across all accounts
behaviours.when: 50 is deposited into a different account 'b' with txn 't1'
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true } but nothing is applied: balance of 'b' is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: txnIds are per account, so 'b' receives the deposit and its balance becomes 50

behaviours.title: txnIds are shared across operation types
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true } but nothing is withdrawn: balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is applied and the balance becomes 50

behaviours.title: Amounts are rounded to cents, half rounds up (0.125 becomes 0.13)
behaviours.then: the balance is 0.13 and the history entry amount is 0.13
behaviours.contrary_then: half-to-even or truncation is used, so the balance is 0.12

behaviours.title: Amounts below half a cent round down (0.124 becomes 0.12)
behaviours.then: the balance is 0.12
behaviours.contrary_then: the amount is kept unrounded and the balance is 0.124

behaviours.title: A positive amount that rounds to 0 cents is accepted as a 0 deposit
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true }, balance is 0 and history holds a deposit entry of amount 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is rejected as invalid-amount because it rounds to nothing

behaviours.title: The running balance itself is not rounded to cents
behaviours.then: the balance reads 0.30000000000000004
behaviours.contrary_then: the balance reads exactly 0.3

behaviours.title: A withdrawal records a withdrawal entry and reduces the balance
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true }, balance is 60 and the last history entry is a withdrawal of 40 with txnId 't2'
behaviours.contrary_then: the balance stays 100

behaviours.title: A withdrawal of 0 is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } and the balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the zero withdrawal is accepted with { ok: true }

behaviours.title: A negative withdrawal is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } and the balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the negative withdrawal is accepted and the balance becomes 150

behaviours.title: Retrying a withdrawal with the same txnId withdraws only once
behaviours.given: account 'a' has a balance of 100 and 30 was withdrawn with txn 't2'
behaviours.when: the withdrawal of 30 with txn 't2' is sent again
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true } and the balance stays 70
behaviours.contrary_then: the retry withdraws again and the balance becomes 40

behaviours.title: Withdrawing the entire balance is allowed (balance may reach exactly 0)
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true } and the balance is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is rejected as insufficient-funds and the balance stays 100

behaviours.title: Withdrawing one cent more than the balance is rejected
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'insufficient-funds' }, balance stays 100 and nothing is added to history
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted and the balance becomes -0.01 (overdraft allowed)

behaviours.title: A withdrawal rejected for insufficient funds can be retried with the same txnId later
behaviours.given: account 'a' has 100, and a withdrawal of 150 with txn 't2' was rejected as insufficient-funds
behaviours.when: 100 more is deposited (txn 't3') and the withdrawal of 150 with txn 't2' is sent again
behaviours.then: the withdrawal now succeeds and the balance is 50
behaviours.contrary_then: the txnId 't2' is considered already used, so the retry is ignored and the balance stays 200

behaviours.title: Withdrawing from an account that was never funded is insufficient-funds
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'insufficient-funds' } and balance of 'x' is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is rejected because the account does not exist (a different reason)

behaviours.title: Insufficient funds is checked before the daily limit
behaviours.then: the reason given is 'insufficient-funds', not 'daily-limit'
behaviours.contrary_then: the reason given is 'daily-limit'

behaviours.title: A single withdrawal of exactly 5000 is within the daily limit
behaviours.given: account 'a' has a balance of 6000 and nothing withdrawn yet
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true } and the balance is 1000
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is rejected as daily-limit because the limit is exclusive

behaviours.title: A single withdrawal of 5000.01 exceeds the daily limit
behaviours.given: account 'a' has a balance of 6000 and nothing withdrawn yet
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'daily-limit' } and the balance stays 6000
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted and the balance becomes 999.99

behaviours.title: Withdrawals accumulate toward the 5000 daily limit
behaviours.given: account 'a' has a balance of 10000 and 3000 was withdrawn (txn 't2')
behaviours.then: the 2000.01 withdrawal is rejected as daily-limit; the 2000 withdrawal succeeds and the balance is 5000
behaviours.contrary_then: the limit applies per withdrawal, so the 2000.01 withdrawal is accepted

behaviours.title: Once 5000 has been withdrawn, even 0.01 more is refused
behaviours.given: account 'a' has a balance of 6000 and 5000 has been withdrawn (txn 't2')
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'daily-limit' } and the balance stays 1000
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted and the balance becomes 999.99

behaviours.title: A withdrawal refused for the daily limit does not count toward the limit
behaviours.given: account 'a' has a balance of 10000 and a withdrawal of 5000.01 (txn 't2') was refused as daily-limit
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true } and the balance is 5000
behaviours.contrary_then: the refused attempt used up the allowance, so this is refused as daily-limit

behaviours.title: The daily limit is tracked per account
behaviours.given: accounts 'a' and 'b' each have a balance of 6000, and 5000 was withdrawn from 'a'
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true } and balance of 'b' is 1000
behaviours.contrary_then: the limit is shared across accounts, so the withdrawal from 'b' is refused as daily-limit

behaviours.title: The 'daily' limit never resets when the date changes
behaviours.given: on 2026-01-01 account 'a' has a balance of 10000 and 5000 was withdrawn
behaviours.when: the clock moves to 2026-01-02 and 1 is withdrawn
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'daily-limit' }
behaviours.contrary_then: the limit resets on the new day and the withdrawal of 1 is accepted

behaviours.title: The daily limit is checked on the rounded amount (5000.004 counts as 5000)
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true }, the withdrawal entry is 5000 and the balance is 1000
behaviours.contrary_then: the unrounded 5000.004 is compared with the limit and the withdrawal is refused as daily-limit

behaviours.title: Transfers do not count toward the daily withdrawal limit
behaviours.when: 6000 is transferred from 'a' to 'b' (txn 't2') and then 5000 is withdrawn from 'a' (txn 't3')
behaviours.then: both succeed; balance of 'a' is 1000 and 'b' is 6000
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer counts toward the limit, so the 5000 withdrawal is refused as daily-limit

behaviours.title: A transfer moves funds and records transfer-out and transfer-in entries
behaviours.when: 40 is transferred from 'a' to 'b' with txn 't2'
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true }; 'a' is 60 with a transfer-out entry of 40, 'b' is 40 with a transfer-in entry of 40, both with txnId 't2'
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is rejected because 'b' was never opened

behaviours.title: A transfer to the same account is accepted and leaves the balance unchanged
behaviours.when: 30 is transferred from 'a' to 'a' with txn 't2'
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true }, the balance stays 100, and history gains a transfer-out of 30 and a transfer-in of 30
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is rejected because source and destination are the same account

behaviours.title: A transfer of 0 is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.when: 0 is transferred from 'a' to 'b' with txn 't2'
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' }
behaviours.contrary_then: the zero transfer is accepted with { ok: true }

behaviours.title: A negative transfer is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.when: -20 is transferred from 'a' to 'b' with txn 't3'
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' }; 'a' stays 100 and 'b' stays 50
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer runs in reverse: 'a' becomes 120 and 'b' becomes 30

behaviours.title: Retrying a transfer with the same txnId moves money only once
behaviours.given: account 'a' has 100 and 40 was transferred to 'b' with txn 't2'
behaviours.when: the transfer of 40 with txn 't2' is sent again
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true }; 'a' stays 60 and 'b' stays 40
behaviours.contrary_then: the retry transfers again: 'a' becomes 20 and 'b' becomes 80

behaviours.title: Transferring the entire balance is allowed
behaviours.when: 100 is transferred from 'a' to 'b' with txn 't2'
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: true }; 'a' is 0 and 'b' is 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is rejected as insufficient-funds

behaviours.title: Transferring one cent more than the balance is rejected
behaviours.when: 100.01 is transferred from 'a' to 'b' with txn 't2'
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'insufficient-funds' }; 'a' stays 100, 'b' stays 0 and neither history changes
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is accepted: 'a' becomes -0.01 and 'b' becomes 100.01

behaviours.title: The history returned by entries is a copy
behaviours.when: the list returned by entries('a') is emptied by the caller and entries('a') is read again
behaviours.then: the second read still has one entry
behaviours.contrary_then: the caller's change affects the ledger and the second read is empty
